summary: Iter 28 — Membership lifecycle (year filter + renew). Backend pytest: 12/12 PASS in test_iteration28_membership_lifecycle.py. Verified: (a) GET /api/members?year=2025 includes seed via current period with _period.is_current=true, year=2030 excludes seed, no year returns all. (b) POST /api/members/{id}/renew archives current period to membership_history with status='Yenilənib' and total/used/remaining_quota + archived_at snapshot, sets new package/contract dates. (c) carry_over_quota=true increases bonus_quota by remaining; carry_over_quota=false leaves bonus_quota unchanged. (d) After renew, year=2025 returns _period.is_current=false (history) and year=2026 returns _period.is_current=true. (e) Unknown member id → 404. (f) Sales role with members:write + scopes.members='own' → renew on admin-owned member returns 403. (g) /api/obligations/dashboard?year=2030 excludes seed, ?year=2025 returns list shape {obligations:[...]}. (h) /api/obligations/company/{id}?year=2025 returns object with quota fields. Frontend Playwright (admin login → /sales/members): year-filter testid present, default text '2026 (cari)'. Row-level dropdown opens row-renew-{id} which opens renew-modal with all 5 testids (renew-package, renew-start, renew-end, renew-carryover, renew-submit-btn). /sales/obligations: obligation-year-filter present, default '2026 (cari)'. /sales/obligation-history: history-year-filter present, default '2026 (cari)'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1759 — `return companies` is followed by ~22 lines of unreachable/dead code (lines 1760–1782) that map fields like company_name/director_name/business_size and compute days_until_expiry. Either delete the dead block or move it before the return; the frontend currently never receives those mapped helpers from /api/members. Members.jsx works because it reads raw fields (brand_name etc) via different paths — but cleanup is recommended.
server.py:1862 renew_member — uses event_date string range query with sentinels '0000-00-00' and '9999-99-99'; works because event_date is stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. Good.
server.py:1891 history entry status hard-coded 'Yenilənib'; consider supporting 'Bitib'/'Ləğv edilib' if non-renew terminations are needed later.
